# Clipper2

Upstream: https://github.com/AngusJohnson/Clipper2

Pinned tag: `Clipper2_2.0.1`, commit `21ebba05db8894f0c7217ad35ea518080f324946`.

Copyright Angus Johnson and the contributors named in the source headers. See LICENSE.txt for the Boost Software License 1.0. The C# library sources are compiled into Zandatsu.dll. Zandatsu uses Clipper2 to combine body contours and triangulate the cut surfaces.

HashCode.cs carries additional .NET Foundation MIT and Yann Collet xxHash BSD 2-Clause notices; see its header and NOTICES.txt. Both license/notice files are included by the deployment target.
